chapters.title: Copilot, AI coding and rapid fire

takeaways: SharePoint Framework solutions are platform-hosted through the tenant app catalog, so supported extensibility avoids fragile DOM manipulation and server maintenance.
Microsoft Graph is the unified gateway to Microsoft 365, but for older products like SharePoint it still lacks full fidelity, so developers must weigh Graph against SharePoint REST.
Libraries like PnPjs remove boilerplate such as token handling, throttling retries and response parsing, and can be extended to any custom API.
hook: Building on Microsoft 365 means choosing between SharePoint Framework, Microsoft Graph, Teams extensibility and Power Platform without breaking on the next update. In this interview, MVP and PnPjs maintainer Julie Turner shares practical guidance for developers and solution architects on supported extensibility, granular permissions and great user experiences. You learn when to use Graph or SharePoint REST and how to use AI without outsourcing your brain.
